intro: At Sentinel Hill in Westfall, Quartermaster Lewis keeps supplies moving to the People's Militia. He serves local defenders and travelers holding the frontier against the Defias Brotherhood.

p: Quartermaster Lewis keeps the militia's supplies in Sentinel Tower. Stormwind's royal leaders offer little aid to impoverished Westfall, so Sentinel Hill depends on local volunteers and whatever provisions they can gather. Lewis hands out field necessities, including dry rations, fresh water, arrows, shot, and throwing blades. The fighters standing watch need these basics to endure Defias raids.
